verdicts.reason: Both fail in the same ways. The headline breaks one word per line ('Win / a / study / grant') against a cramped left edge, 'Xavier Sport Program' runs into the right canvas edge, the tennis ball and the divider rules are gone, the photo is mostly hidden under a lopsided blue slab, and the subtitle floats off to the right of the headline. A also has a stray, clipped blue rectangle at the top right. B is slightly less bad: its headline has a little left padding and its leftover top-right element is only a thin bar, though that bar is still out of place.
